description: The file defines the PooledQueueCache class, which implements an in-memory cache for streaming messages in Orleans framework, optimized for high-performance message storage with pooled memory management. It includes methods for adding, removing, and enumerating cached messages, and maintains metadata for purging and monitoring.

classes.name: PooledQueueCache
classes.description: A cache designed to store large numbers of messages for extended periods with minimal performance impact, utilizing pooled memory and optimized for queue-specific stream caching.

classes.name: PooledQueueCache.Cursor
classes.description: Helper class to navigate through cached messages via a stream-specific cursor.

methods.name: PooledQueueCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing the pooled queue cache with dependencies and optional purge intervals.

methods.name: ReportCacheMessageStatistics
methods.description: Reports statistics about the cache, including message counts and timestamps.

methods.name: PurgeMetadata
methods.description: Removes purge metadata entries older than the configured interval.

methods.name: TrackAndPurgeMetadata
methods.description: Updates purge metadata for a message and triggers purging if necessary.

methods.name: SetCursor
methods.description: Positions the cursor to a specific sequence token within the cache.

methods.name: TryGetNextMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the next message from the cache according to the cursor.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a list of messages to the cache.

methods.name: Add (private)
methods.description: Adds a single message to the cache, allocating from the pool.

methods.name: RemoveOldestMessage
methods.description: Removes the oldest message from the cache and cleans up empty blocks.
